description: Admin client app: auth context + hooks, route guards, layout, all five admin pages, the admin stylesheet, and routing/provider wiring in App.tsx. Depends on FEAT-001 (imports roles/format/applications/adminApi and the extended firebase.ts). Leaves the app buildable and the public site untouched.
steps: Create src/admin/useAuth.ts (NON-component module): export the AuthContext React context object (createContext with the value type { user: User|null, role: Role|null, loading: boolean, logout: () => Promise<void> }), the useAuth() hook (useContext + throw if used outside provider), and useRole() returning the roles.ts predicates bound to the current role. This file exports NO components so the component files stay lint-clean.

Create src/admin/AuthContext.tsx exporting ONLY the AuthProvider component. GUARD FIRST: if import.meta.env.DEV && import.meta.env.VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE === '1', synchronously provide a fake { user, role } derived from window.__ADMIN_TEST_ROLE__ (loading=false), create NO onAuthStateChanged subscription, and call no firebase/auth method. Otherwise subscribe via onAuthStateChanged(auth, ...); on a signed-in user call user.getIdToken(true) once then user.getIdTokenResult() and read claims.role (unknown/undefined -> role=null); keep loading=true until the first auth state + claims resolve; logout() calls signOut(auth). Declare the window.__ADMIN_TEST_ROLE__ global via a small ambient type (e.g. an interface merge) kept inside src so tsc sees it.

Create src/admin/RequireAuth.tsx (component only): while loading render a spinner; if no user render <Navigate to='/admin/login' state={{ from: location }} replace /> using useLocation(); if user but role===null render a Hebrew access-denied screen ('אין לך הרשאת גישה') with a logout button (FR-1.6); otherwise render <Outlet/>.

Create src/admin/RequireRole.tsx (component only): <RequireRole allow={Role[]} redirect?='/admin'>children</RequireRole>; if the current role is not in allow, either <Navigate to={redirect} replace/> (when redirect given, for route gating) or render nothing (inline control gating); else render children.

Create src/admin/admin.css: one stylesheet, all classes prefixed .admin-* / .adm-*, referencing global brand tokens var(--navy) etc. (defined in src/index.css — do NOT edit index.css). Include styles for topbar, side nav, cards, table, detail, forms, badges, spinner.

Create src/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: brand topbar (logo, current user email, role badge, logout button) + side nav with items לוח בקרה (/admin), מועמדים (/admin/applications), and ניהול מנהלים (/admin/admins) where the admins item renders only when canManageAdmins(role). Renders <Outlet/>. Imports admin.css. Does NOT use the public Header/Footer.

Create src/admin/LoginPage.tsx (/admin/login): Hebrew email/password form, signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, ...); on success navigate to location.state?.from?.pathname ?? '/admin'; if already authenticated redirect away from login; map auth error codes to Hebrew ('אימייל או סיסמה שגויים' for invalid-credential/wrong-password/user-not-found, 'יותר מדי ניסיונות, נסו שוב מאוחר יותר', 'החשבון מושבת', 'בעיית רשת, נסו שוב'); inline empty-field validation before any network call; console.error raw code only (never shown to user).

Create src/admin/DashboardPage.tsx (/admin): summary stat cards (total + per-status counts + last-7-days) computed from getCountFromServer aggregate queries, plus a compact recent-applications preview linking to the list. Honor the FEAT-001 fixture path in DEV+flag mode (counts from fixtures).

Create src/admin/ApplicationsPage.tsx (/admin/applications): paginated table with 'load more' via fetchApplicationsPage cursor; server status filter (where('status',...)+orderBy) with graceful 'שגיאת טעינה, נסו לרענן' + retry on failed-precondition/unavailable (index not yet deployed) logging the index link to console; client-side free-text search over the loaded set (name/email/phone/city, trimmed+lowercased); client-side column sort (name/createdAt/status, default createdAt desc); CSV export via toCsv/downloadCsv (button disabled at 0 rows; gender column built via genderLabelHe, non-gender missing -> '—'); export button gated by canExport(role). In DEV+flag mode the fixture source filters client-side (no index dependency).

Create src/admin/ApplicationDetailPage.tsx (/admin/applications/:id): render all fields with '—' for missing/empty non-gender fields and genderLabelHe for gender; a status <select> (admin/superadmin only, gated by canEditApplications) calling setApplicationStatus with optimistic update + revert on failure and Hebrew error mapping; audit history via subscribeApplicationHistory rendering each entry (actorEmail, from->to, formatted at via formatDateTimeHe, pending null -> 'שומר…'); unknown :id -> 'המועמד לא נמצא' empty state; permission-denied -> 'אין הרשאה' with logout/refresh.

Create src/admin/AdminsPage.tsx (/admin/admins, superadmin-only): list admins via listAdmins() (uid, email, role, grantedByEmail, grantedAt); a grant form (email input + role select) calling grantRole; revoke buttons calling revokeAdmin; map guard errors (last superadmin 'לא ניתן להסיר את מנהל העל האחרון', self) and not-found to Hebrew. DEV+flag mode operates over fixtures.

Edit src/App.tsx: import AuthProvider from '@/admin/AuthContext', the guards, AdminLayout, and the pages via the '@/admin/*' alias. Wrap the returned <Routes> in <AuthProvider>. Keep the existing public routes under <Route element={<RootLayout/>}> unchanged. Add: <Route path='admin/login' element={<LoginPage/>} />; <Route path='admin' element={<RequireAuth/>}> with a child <Route element={<AdminLayout/>}> containing index=<DashboardPage/>, path='applications'=<ApplicationsPage/>, path='applications/:id'=<ApplicationDetailPage/>, and path='admins' wrapped in <RequireRole allow={['superadmin']} redirect='/admin'><AdminsPage/></RequireRole>. Do NOT edit src/main.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint is clean with ZERO react-refresh/only-export-components warnings (hooks isolated in useAuth.ts; .tsx files export only components).
src/main.tsx is unchanged; public routes still wrapped by RootLayout; admin routes are outside RootLayout so the public Header/Footer never render in /admin.
The 'ניהול מנהלים' nav item and status/export controls are conditional on role via roles.ts predicates.
verification: npm run lint   (expect clean, zero warnings)
findings: Implemented the full admin client app under src/admin/ (useAuth.ts, AuthContext.tsx, RequireAuth.tsx, RequireRole.tsx, admin.css, AdminLayout.tsx, LoginPage.tsx, DashboardPage.tsx, ApplicationsPage.tsx, ApplicationDetailPage.tsx, AdminsPage.tsx) and wired routes/AuthProvider in src/App.tsx. Verification: `npm run build` exits 0 (tsc -b + vite build); `npm run lint` is clean with ZERO warnings (hooks + AuthContext object isolated in useAuth.ts so every .tsx exports only components). Protected files untouched: src/main.tsx, src/components/ApplyWizard.tsx, src/lib/webhook.ts, functions/index.js. Notes for later steps: (1) Provider wraps <Routes> INSIDE App.tsx per design; main.tsx unchanged. (2) DEV test-mode: AuthProvider reads window.__ADMIN_TEST_ROLE__ (a Role string, or 'none'/null/undefined = signed-out); the Window augmentation lives in AuthContext.tsx. When import.meta.env.DEV && VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE==='1' it provides a synchronous fake value and makes NO firebase/auth call. (3) DashboardPage computes live stats via getCountFromServer (total, per-status over STATUS_ORDER, last-7-days via createdAt>=ISO cutoff) and falls back to fixture-derived counts in test mode — NOTE this last-7-days query adds a createdAt range filter that FEAT (indexes) should ensure is covered; per-status + createdAt ordering already needs the composite index. (4) ApplicationsPage logs an index-missing hint to console and shows 'שגיאת טעינה, נסו לרענן' + retry on failed-precondition/unavailable; export button gated by canExport and disabled at 0 rows; search over name/email/phone/city; default sort createdAt desc. (5) RBAC gating uses roles.ts predicates via useRole(); 'ניהול מנהלים' nav item + admins route are superadmin-only; status <select> gated by canEditApplications. (6) Admin routes are OUTSIDE RootLayout so the public Header/Footer never render under /admin. Routing specs (admin-routing.spec.ts) and RBAC specs (admin-rbac.spec.ts) are a later FEAT's responsibility and were not added here.
